name: 07732 · Highlands, NJ
findings: ZIP 07732 (Highlands) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07732 (Highlands) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
53% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07732 (Highlands) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
